new:

                &context.task_id,
                &run,
                AgentRunBenchmarkIdentity {
                    backend_id: &context.backend_id,

                    inventory: context.inventory.as_ref(),
                    quality: context.quality,
                    workload: context.workload,
                    hardware: &context.hardware,
                },
            )
